solos.target: Solo's Holidays 2002 Limited (04511481), later Arnloft 2002 Limited
solos.transaction: Proposed acquisition of 100% of the Solo's parent/business perimeter, integrated with signed UK sales/distribution arrangements for Sun Park.
solos.payment_mechanism: The signed exclusivity/commercial structure provided for Net Payments generated under the commercial arrangements to accumulate toward the acquisition price, including escrow/set-off mechanics. Transaction-level amounts remain to be reconciled from bank, escrow, booking and ledger evidence.
solos.performance_position: Gil Marer states that the group made incremental payments/performance toward the acquisition price while the acquisition remained uncompleted.
solos.failure_and_causation: Gil Marer states that events in Spain materially caused the Sun Rock side to breach or become unable to complete the acquisition and that the acquisition was consequently lost. This is a causation and damages position requiring condition-by-condition proof; it is not yet an adjudicated finding.
solos.later_history: The current controlled record states that the Solo's business/assets were later acquired by a third party in April 2019. Companies House later records company no. 04511481 as Arnloft 2002 Limited and dissolved. Exact transaction, members' voluntary liquidation and dissolution dates remain to be pinned to primary filings.
solos.evidential_use: The abandoned acquisition file, professional work, signed commercial agreements, payments, escrow architecture, diligence, funding work and operating integration are contemporaneous evidence of the scale, maturity and direction of the Sun Rock platform before the Spanish disruption.
solos.damages_use: Potential heads of loss include sunk professional/transaction costs, acquisition payments or credited Net Payments, loss of contractual/exclusivity rights, loss of acquired-business opportunity, lost distribution margin/capability, lost platform growth and consequential enterprise-value effects. Each head requires legal entitlement, causation, remoteness, mitigation, valuation and double-counting controls.
solos.no_double_count_rule: Do not count the same booking receipt, acquisition payment, lost margin, goodwill, enterprise value or hotel-income loss twice across LPB, Pink, Hava Vida, AWESWELL LIMITED or personal claimant positions.
